name: Living the Dream
source:
Meet Naleth, born as a warrior princess, and raised to be a huntress. But she's always felt different and dreamed of living a different kind of life.

After the mysterious Reeve visits her village, she wakes up the next day as him! Living his life, working at his office. She's never been happier, but Reeve doesn't understand why. After all, Reeve has always dreamed of living in Naleth's world, and being someone else...

Living the Dream is a visual novel adventure that explores the nature of identity, inverts the themes of many classical fairy tales, and challenges what it means to follow your dreams.

[from [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/2052836802/1533519524?ref=6u1srw&token=1374eba8]Kickstarter[/url]]
translation:
来认识一下娜莱丝吧——她生为战士公主，自幼被当作女猎手抚养长大；但她始终觉得自己格格不入，梦想着过上截然不同的人生。

在神秘男子里夫造访她的村庄后，第二天醒来时，她竟变成了他的模样！过着他的生活，在他的办公室里上班——她从未如此快乐过，可里夫却百思不得其解。毕竟，里夫一直以来梦寐以求的，恰恰是活在娜莱丝的世界里，成为另一个人……

《Living the Dream》是一部视觉小说冒险游戏，旨在探讨身份认同的本质，颠覆诸多经典童话的传统母题，并对“追逐梦想究竟意味着什么”提出拷问。

[摘自[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/2052836802/1533519524?ref=6u1srw&token=1374eba8]Kickstarter[/url]]
